headline: VoiceStudio Keeps Synthesis on Your Machine
lede: VoiceStudio brings voice cloning, dubbing, audiobook production, and video processing into a local-first desktop application. With 646 languages, swappable speech engines, and acceleration for CUDA, Apple Silicon, and ROCm, it keeps models and project data away from external servers.

headline: Paperclip Organizes Agents Into Working Teams
lede: Paperclip gives autonomous agents an operating structure: roles, goals, budgets, permissions, and persistent state. Its Node.js server and React control plane turn scattered model sessions into an auditable organization that can coordinate Claude, Codex, and custom agents.

headline: Hindsight Gives Agents a Durable Memory
lede: Hindsight builds memory around three linked operations: retain, recall, and reflect. Its deployment options, SDKs, and support for more than 100 model providers let developers add evolving knowledge and continuity to agent systems without rebuilding their entire stack.

headline: OpenRig Maps a Modular Radar System
lede: AERIS-10 opens the design of a 10.5 GHz phased-array radar, from FPGA signal processing to beam steering and target tracking. The project documents schematics, PCBs, firmware, and two range-oriented configurations for researchers and advanced radio builders.

headline: A Systems Textbook Built in the Open
lede: The CS 341 coursebook turns systems programming into a maintained, citable open text for C and Linux-oriented study. Automated exports to PDF, Markdown, and HTML support a collaborative editorial process grounded in footnotes, glossaries, and technical review.

headline: Up Turns Lifelong Learning Into Evidence
lede: Up treats learning as a cycle of problem, deliberate study, AI collaboration, tangible work, and review. Its worksheets, evidence cards, checklists, and 90-day plans give students and career changers a playful but concrete way to turn effort into transferable proof.

headline: OpenRig Runs a Persistent Coding Crew
lede: OpenRig turns tmux, YAML, SQLite, and a terminal dashboard into a durable multi-agent development harness. It lets teams assign named roles to Claude Code and Codex, preserve project state, route messages, and keep human verification in the loop.

headline: Univer Embeds Office Tools Everywhere
lede: Univer supplies a plugin-first foundation for spreadsheets, documents, and presentations with a high-performance Canvas renderer. Its shared browser-and-Node.js API supports both quick presets and deeply customized office surfaces, including headless workflows for AI-driven products.
